parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The application ID for interactive messages.

parameters.name: BroadCastType
parameters.description:
The system message diffusion type. Valid values:

- 0: No diffusion.
- 1: Diffusion to specified users.
- 2: Diffusion to the group.

parameters.name: OperatorUserId
parameters.description: The user ID of the operator. This user must be the creator of the group.
